maintenance_items.notes: Severe use: replace every 5,000 miles/8,000 km or 6 months, whichever comes first.
Standard: replace every 7,500 miles/12,000 km or 6 months, whichever comes first.
Rotate tires at 7,500-mile/6-month standard intervals (e.g., 7,500; 15,000; 22,500 … miles).

Severe use: replace brake fluid every 10,000 miles or 12 months. Appears at 10k/12mo, 20k/24mo, 30k/36mo, 40k/48mo, 50k/60mo, 60k/72mo, 70k/84mo, 80k/96mo, 90k/108mo, 100k/120mo, 110k/132mo per severe schedule pages.
Standard: replace brake fluid every 30,000 miles or 24 months. Appears at 30k/24mo, 60k/48mo, 90k/72mo per standard schedule pages.
Replace in-cabin microfilter approximately every 15,000 miles under standard schedule. Appears at 15,000; 30,000; 45,000; 60,000; 75,000; 90,000; 105,000 miles per schedule pages.
Replace engine air filter every 30,000 miles (at 30,000; 60,000; 90,000 miles per schedule). If operating mainly in dusty conditions, more frequent maintenance may be required.

Inspect CVT fluid at 15,000; 30,000; 45,000; 60,000; 75,000; 90,000; 105,000 miles under standard schedule. If using a car-top carrier or driving on rough/muddy roads, replace CVT fluid every 60,000 miles (96,000 km) or request dealer to inspect fluid deterioration data using CONSULT; if deterioration data is more than 210,000, replace the CVT fluid.
Replace CVT fluid at 60,000 miles/72 months per severe schedule page 502. Pattern not perfectly uniform across schedule.
Replace spark plugs at 105,000 miles. Performed based on mileage only. Replace spark plug when the plug gap exceeds 0.053 in (1.35 mm) even if within specified replacement mileage.

First replacement at 105,000 miles (168,000 km) or 84 months. After first replacement, replace every 75,000 miles (120,000 km) or 60 months. Marked with * (recommended by NISSAN for reliable vehicle operation; not required to maintain emission warranty).
Replace Intelligent Key battery approximately every 22,500 miles/18 months. Appears at 45,000; 67,500; 90,000; 112,500 miles per standard schedule.
Intelligent Key battery inspection noted at 22,500 miles/18 months under standard schedule.

Inspect engine drive belt at 60,000; 75,000; 90,000; 105,000 miles per standard schedule. First at 60,000 miles, then every 15,000 miles. Marked with * (recommended by NISSAN for reliable vehicle operation; not required to maintain emission warranty).

Genuine NISSAN CVT Fluid NS-3 (or equivalent). Do not mix with other fluids. Do not use ATF or manual transmission fluid.

extraction_caveats: 1. The maintenance schedule is presented as a milestone-by-milestone list (not a simple repeating grid), so intervals were reconstructed by analyzing the pattern across all milestones. 2. Brake fluid: Under standard schedule, replaced at 30,000; 60,000; 90,000 miles (every 30,000 mi/24 mo). Under severe schedule, replaced at 10,000; 20,000; 30,000; 40,000; 50,000; 60,000; 70,000; 80,000; 90,000; 100,000; 110,000 miles (every 10,000 mi/12 mo). 3. CVT fluid: Inspected at 15,000; 30,000; 45,000; 60,000; 75,000; 90,000; 105,000 miles (standard); replaced at 60,000 mi/72 mo per severe schedule page 502. Under severe conditions (car-top carrier or rough/muddy roads), replace every 60,000 miles or per CONSULT deterioration data. 4. Engine coolant first replacement is at 105,000 miles/84 months; subsequent replacements every 75,000 miles/60 months. 5. Spark plugs are replaced based on mileage only (not months) at 105,000 miles. 6. In-cabin microfilter replacement pattern from schedule: 15,000; 30,000; 45,000; 60,000; 75,000; 90,000; 105,000 miles — approximately every 15,000 miles. 7. Intelligent Key battery: inspected at 22,500 mi; replaced at 45,000; 67,500; 90,000; 112,500 miles — approximately every 22,500 miles. 8. Items marked with 'both' schedule appear at every severe (5,000 mi) and standard (7,500 mi) interval as general inspection items. 9. Pages 538–541 are index pages; fluid and maintenance data sourced from pages 448, 453, 490–510, 514, 518, 546.
